newsitem.title: CHINA: China Volkswagen to boost '97 car output.
newsitem.headline: China Volkswagen to boost '97 car output.

text.p: Shanghai Volkswagen, a subsidiary of Volkswagen AG, will produce 230,000 of its Santana sedan car in 1997 and expects to chalk up 35 billion yuan in sales, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The firm turned out 200,000 Santana cars last year and sold 196,000. The car is the biggest selling sedan in China, with market share standing at 52 percent last year.
By end-1996, the Sino-German joint venture had produced 746,000 Santana cars, including 104,000 Santana-2000-type luxury cars made last year.
The localisation ratio of the basic Santana was now 90 percent, and 80 percent for the Santana-2000, Xinhua said.
